title: Serverwars
description: Enable your server to create a lobby, join the queue, and start a Serverwar!
body:
#
[![Serverwars](https://serverwars.net/public/images/title_servers.png)](https://serverwars.net/) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/user/Woutimus) [![Hangar](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/hangar_vector.svg)](https://hangar.papermc.io/Wout/) [![Unsupported spigot](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/unsupported/spigot_vector.svg)]() [![discord-plural](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/social/discord-plural_46h.png)](https://discord.gg/qzEstJKn7b)
## Serverwars Team up with players from your server and battle against other servers through a series of minigames. With this plugin, your server can: - Create a lobby and enter the matchmaking queue - Compete against other servers in tournaments ## How it works 1. Players join a lobby together. 2. The lobby enters the Serverwars matchmaking queue. 3. The plugin searches for another server to play against. 4. When a match is found, a dedicated event server is started on the Serverwars network. This new server is a fair and isolated environment where players from both servers can compete against each other. 5. Players from both servers join this event server for the duration of the game. 6. Once the game is over, everyone is automatically sent back to their original servers.



## What does this plugin do? **All commands and all permissions**: https://serverwars.net/docs/plugin/commands This plugin make events seamless for players and automates things like matchmaking and tournaments. Commands to create a lobby of players: - `/serverwars lobby` (interactive menu) - `/serverwars lobby create` - `/serverwars lobby invite` - `/serverwars lobby join` - `/serverwars lobby leave` - `/serverwars lobby kick` Commands to enter and leave the match making queue: - `/serverwars queue enter` - `/serverwars queue leave` Commands related to an active game server: - `/serverwars match enter` And extra commands like: - `/serverwars config reload` ## Installation Paper 1.21.11 with Java 21 (or higher) is required. Plugin should also work on Paper forks. Spigot is not supported. ## Support We are mostly active on Discord so the best way to get support is joining our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/qzEstJKn7b). Find more info on: [https://serverwars.net/](https://serverwars.net/)
